definitions.explanation: The disposal of a dead body by burning. The standard funeral practice in Japan, where the cremation rate is over 99%.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{火葬|かそう}が{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
{葬儀|そうぎ}の{後|あと}、{火葬場|かそうば}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: After the funeral, we headed to the crematorium.

examples.japanese: {故人|こじん}の{遺志|いし}により、{火葬|かそう}は{家族|かぞく}だけで{静|しず}かに{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Following the wishes of the deceased, the cremation was held quietly with only family present.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan has one of the highest cremation rates in the world. After cremation, family members use chopsticks to pick the bones from the ashes and place them in an urn ({骨壺|こつつぼ}), a practice called {骨上|こつあ}げ or お{骨拾|こつひろ}い.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火葬|かそう}する: to cremate
- {火葬場|かそうば}: crematorium
- {火葬|かそう}{許可証|きょかしょう}: cremation permit
